meta.name: sheet clip (locked)
meta.note: the two halves in the position they take under load: the knob's neck sitting at the far end of the slot, which is where the elastic drives it

features.note: the neck is round and so is the slot's end cap, so concentric on those two is the locked position; the offset drops the knob until its neck straddles the plate, tail disc below and flared head above
